items.title: 【开源自荐】PaperMate，集成了翻译agent，对照阅读，agent解析，知识问答和划词解释的论文阅读助手
items.author: chinrain
items.summary: PaperMate PaperMate 是 AI 学术论文分析助手，支持论文解析、翻译、术语记忆与自适应对话。 功能简介 1. 论文解析与翻译（保留格式） 论文解析为 Markdown 后进行翻译，结构与公式不丢失 中英对照阅读界面 翻译采用 ReAct Agent 架构：结合 arXiv 与网络检索，补充背景、动机与切入点 输出强相关论文链接，并给出相关性说明 深度解析核心创新点：是什么、为什么重要、与已有方法对比、关键模块细节 给出实验结果、优势与局限性 提供 AI 推断的可行未来方向 2. 术语记忆与全局高亮 划词触发 AI 解析专业术语 解析后在项目内全局高亮 鼠标悬停显示术语解释与上下文 3. 用户画像驱动的论文对话 对话中自动更新用户画像 AI 根据画像实时调整回答深度与表达方式
items.content: https://github.com/chinrain/PaperMate # PaperMate PaperMate 是 AI 学术论文分析助手，支持论文解析、翻译、术语记忆与自适应对话。 ## 功能简介 ### 1. 论文解析与翻译（保留格式） - 论文解析为 Markdown 后进行翻译，结构与公式不丢失 - 中英对照阅读界面 - 翻译采用 ReAct Agent 架构：结合 arXiv 与网络检索，补充背景、动机与切入点 - 输出强相关论文链接，并给出相关性说明 - 深度解析核心创新点：是什么、为什么重要、与已有方法对比、关键模块细节 - 给出实验结果、优势与局限性 - 提供 AI 推断的可行未来方向 ### 2. 术语记忆与全局高亮 - 划词触发 AI 解析专业术语 - 解析后在项目内全局高亮 - 鼠标悬停显示术语解释与上下文 ### 3. 用户画像驱动的论文对话 - 对话中自动更新用户画像 - AI 根据画像实时调整回答深度与表达方式

items.title: 【项目自荐】Aimmar: 全球首个Vibe LoRA 智能体 ｜ The World’s First Vibe LoRA AI Agent
items.author: g29times
items.summary: Description Aimmar — 一种全新的 AI 代理系统，专为实现 Vibe LoRA（对话式审美控制技术）而构建。 一句话介绍 Aimmar 不是一个简单的绘画工具，而是一个拥有独立 Runtime 和审美记忆的 Agent 系统，通过对话与交互将你的“创意氛围（Vibe）”转化为可进化的动态 LoRA。 项目深度解析 (System Architecture) Aimmar 的存在是为了解决传统 AI 创作中“风格不可延续”的痛点。我们认为：风格不应是被预设的指令，而是在交互中被发现的共鸣。 不同于传统的 Web UI，Aimmar 是一个具备 Aesthetic Memory（审美记忆） 的代理系统： 不仅仅是界面： 它拥有自己的决策逻辑和运行环境，能够跨会话保持创意连续性。 从 Prompt 到 Vibe： 摒弃枯燥的参数调试，Aimmar 能够从你的对话信号中解读“审美意图”，并实时将其转化为动态的 LoRA 状态。 Workspace 协作： 在画布式的空间内，Agent 在后台管理风格演化，用户在前台进行灵感碰撞。 核心技术栈 (The Aimmar Edge) VibeDynamic LoRA (VDL): 业界首个将对话信号直接映射为模型权重偏移的算法引擎。 Aesthetic Continuity Logic: 确保在长周期的项目迭代中，视觉风格不会因为单次 Prompt 的偏差而产生剧烈抖动（Style Drift）。 Agentic Runtime: 独立于界面的 Agent 逻辑层，负责处理审美意图的提取、存储与调用。 为什么关注 Aimmar？ 在生成式 AI 进入“存量竞争”的时代，Aimmar 重新定义了人机边界。我们不追求一次性的惊艳生成，我们追求的是让 AI 真正“懂”你的审美偏好，并让这种偏好随着你的每一次反馈而不断进化。 Vibe LoRA 定义了对话式风格控制的上限，而 Aimmar 则是这一理论唯一的工程化实现。

items.title: [工具自荐] DeleteThreads - 高效清理 Threads时间线
items.author: mylysddp
items.summary: 项目名称： DeleteThreads 项目地址： 简介： DeleteThreads 是一款旨在帮助用户高效清理 Threads 历史动态、重置社交时间线的实用工具。 在使用 Threads 这种流式社交媒体一段时间后，很多用户会面临一个困扰：Profile 页面堆积了大量的过时发帖、转发和回复，这不仅让个人主页显得杂乱，也带来了隐私隐患。然而，Meta 官方目前并没有提供批量管理功能，用户想要清理历史痕迹，只能一条条手动点击删除，操作效率极低。 我开发 DeleteThreads 的初衷是为用户提供一种“一键重置”的可能性。无论是为了保护个人隐私，还是想要在不注销账号的前提下彻底清理时间线、重塑社交形象，用户都可以通过它快速、安全地批量删除选定的内容，从繁琐的手动操作中解脱出来。 特点： 高效清理： 支持批量管理 Threads 帖子、回复和转发，一键清理冗余的时间线。 隐私重置： 帮助用户快速抹除旧有的社交痕迹，实现“数字断舍离”。 操作直观： 针对 Meta 复杂的权限逻辑进行了优化，提供简单明了的清理流程。 安全合规： 遵循平台安全规范，在保护用户隐私的前提下完成内容处理。

items.title: 【内容自荐】在AI时代，写日记才是正经事
items.author: joeytoday
items.summary: 使用 Qwen Code Skills 进行本地日记的年度复盘内容： 🎬 演示视频 随着 Vibe Coding 大行其道，AI 一天能够生产的内容能超过一个人一年能生产的内容，但又由于 AI 有着幻觉，所有人就得跟着给它 review，AI 有时候并没有解放我们，反而是让我们更多卷进了效率竞赛中，越来越焦虑。我们要知道，AI 是人类的工具，而不是人类的鞭子。 正在此时刻，刚好看到有两位大神都不约而同选择了开始写日记（谁说写日记不正经🐶） 一位是作家马伯庸，他在 2024 年底选择重拾写日记的习惯，只记录事件，大白话就是写流水账；另一个是 AI 大神 Andrej Karpathy。他的日记更极简——只有一个备忘录文档，采用 Appendonly 模式：想到什么就往顶部丢，不打标签、不分类、不设层级，像用剪切板一样用日记。 归根结底，就是降低记录的摩擦力，把记录的阻力降到最低。 这种极简的内容，正非常适合 AI 进行分析，帮助我们了解自己，为什么呢？ 第一，语义密度高。流水账里全是人名、书名、事件、时间、地点，这些都是 AI 最容易提取的结构化信息。不像抒情散文，“今天的夕阳让我想起故乡的麦田”——AI只能回你一句“情感分析：怀旧”。 第二，上下文友好。一年流水账可能只有几万字，完美适配大模型上下文窗口。而一篇精心雕琢的文档，动辄上千字，还充满非事实的内容，AI读完只会说：“人类，你的情绪很复杂。” 第三，无表演性。当日记只为给自己看，我们才敢记下“今天又刷了3小时短视频”这样的“失败事实”。而想要观察真实的自己，最需要避免的就是自我美化和表演欲。 就相当于你构建了属于自己的记忆库。

items.content: Turn data into insights with AskEnola, an AI-powered data analyst. Your AI Data Analyst delivers dashboards, analytics, visualizations, and faster decisions.

items.title: SupaNurse
items.summary: The all-in-one AI platform for nursing students & nurses
items.content: SupaNurse combines NCLEX prep, clinical simulations, AI-powered study tools, nurse documentation, drug references, and career tools in one platform. Whether you're in nursing school or at the bedside, level up your skills with AI that understands nursing.

items.title: Snow Day AI Calculator
items.summary: Predict school closures & snow days instantly with AI
items.content: Snow Day AI Calculator predicts the probability of school closures due to snow and severe winter weather using AI-powered analysis and real-time forecasts. Users can simply enter their ZIP code or city to receive instant, percentage-based snow day predictions. The tool is free to use and does not require any signup or registration. It is designed to be fast, accurate, and easy to use on any device.

items.title: Cookie Jar Savings
items.summary: Save for stuff you actually want
items.content: A beautifully simple savings app that lets you watch your goal fill up with every deposit. 🍪 Physics-based cookie jar with liquid fill animation 🎉 Milestone celebrations at 25%, 50%, 75%, 100% 🌍 9 languages with automatic detection 💰 Savings plan calculator to hit your target on time 🔔 Smart reminders to keep you on track 🎁 Limited time: For the PH community, Cookie Jar Pro is just $2.99 (one-time): removes ALL ads and unlocks unlimited goals.

items.title: Recipe Shelf
items.summary: Your scattered recipes, finally organized
items.content: Stop losing recipes to browser bookmarks and screenshots. Recipe Shelf saves recipes from 15 popular sites (AllRecipes, BBC Good Food, Serious Eats, etc. with more to come), lets you upload photos of handwritten recipes or cookbook pages, and keeps everything organized in one beautiful collection. Scale recipes up or down, tag and filter your collection, and access it from any device.

items.title: HueBuddy
items.summary: AI-Powered Paint Mixing Tool for Artists & Art Students
items.content: HueBuddy helps artists mix paint with confidence. Upload a photo and get precise, paint mixing recipes using real, physical pigments - not digital colour values.

items.title: SQL4Sheets
items.summary: Run real SQL in Google Sheets with zero setup
items.content: Say goodbye to XLOOKUP, pivot tables, and ARRAYFORMULA. Run real SQL in Google Sheets. Fast, local, zero setup. No database? No problem! - Real SQL: SQL4Sheets supports all SQL syntax and functionality. - Query Results: Results will be written to the sheet, no more copy and paste. - Query History: Keep query history privately in your sheets. - Completely Local: Queries run in your browser. We cannot see your data or queries. - High Performance: Most queries finish in seconds.

items.title: Pillzy
items.summary: Medication, Vitamin & Supplement Reminder
items.content: Stay on track with your health! Pillzy is your complete medicine tracker app for medications, vitamins, and supplements. Smart reminders, flexible scheduling, and clear history tracking help you never miss a dose.

items.title: Franklin AI
items.summary: Personalized AI powered financial advice
items.content: Where does your money go? Franklin AI was built by a former investment banker, private equity associate, and hedge fund managing director to answer this question. Franklin AI analyzes your permissioned financial data to uncover hidden leaks, optimize spending, and strengthen your future.

items.title: Multilingual calls for B2B teams
items.summary: Real-time translation for Zoom, Meet & Teams
items.content: Stop losing deals because of language barriers. Heekoo translates your Zoom/Meet/Teams calls in real-time + turns your screen recordings into multilingual support videos. One platform for Sales, Support & CS teams. This is our V1, and we’re actively looking for feedback.

items.title: The Chat Widget — 3KB Live Chat
items.summary: Live chat built for speed, privacy, and developers.
items.content: The Chat Widget is the world’s lightest live chat — just 7KB. Most chat tools load 200KB+ and hurt performance. This one doesn’t. Why it stands out: • 20–35× smaller than Intercom, Drift, Zendesk • Zero tracking & zero cookies by default • GDPR-ready out of the box • Works on slow 3G connections • Free forever plan Built for developers and founders who care about page speed, privacy, and clean installs. Install in 30 seconds on WordPress, Shopify, React, or any site.

items.title: BookFoldPro
items.summary: The most advanced 3D Book Folding engine. 100% Free.
items.content: The first professional-grade book folding studio that runs in your browser. Create MMF, Shadow, and Lenticular patterns with real-time 3D simulation and 0.01mm precision. Stop paying for basic templates generate your own masterpieces for free.

items.title: Glass World Industries
items.summary: Glass & metal company in dubai, uae
items.content: Glass World Industries in Dubai delivers expert glass fabrication, architectural glazing, metal doors & windows, installation, repair, and maintenance.

items.title: PLAYPICK.GG
items.summary: Find your next favorite Steam game in seconds
items.content: I got tired of scrolling through Steam's messy store trying to find something new to play. So I built this. Just type what you're in the mood for - like "cozy roguelike with good music" or "something like Hades but easier" - and it actually understands what you mean. No accounts needed. No ads. Just paste your Steam library link and it'll skip games you already own. Works for 50k+ games. Give it a shot.

items.title: Squared Away
items.summary: Smart storage organization
items.content: Stop wasting hours searching for your stuff. Snap a photo—AI identifies and organizes it instantly. Search naturally: "where's my drill?" Get exact locations in seconds. Organize by room → furniture → shelf → container, just like your physical space. Lightning-fast search. Works on iOS, Android & web. Perfect for homeowners, collectors, downsizers, and anyone tired of garage chaos. Get organized in minutes, not hours.

items.title: Habit Pixel
items.summary: Build habits that stick, one pixel at a time
items.content: Habit Pixel transforms habit tracking into something you actually want to do. Watch your progress fill a satisfying pixel grid as you build streaks and crush your goals. ✓ Pixel dashboard & widgets ✓ Daily, weekly & monthly streak goals ✓ Multi check-ins & per-day targets ✓ Smart reminders with quick actions ✓ Notes & mood journaling ✓ Works offline—no account needed Stop tracking habits in boring lists. Start watching your consistency take shape.

items.title: Magic Table Planner
items.summary: Free drag-and-drop seating chart maker for weddings & events
items.content: Magic Table Planner is a free, browser-based tool for creating wedding and event seating charts. Just drag guests onto tables and watch your plan come together. Features include guest list management with dietary tracking, real-time capacity monitoring, multiple table shapes, and export to PDF or PowerPoint. No download required, works on any device, available in 18 languages. Perfect for weddings, corporate events, and any gathering where seating matters.

items.title: Bridge4Simulator MCP
items.summary: MCP server that gives AI the ability to use an iPhone
items.content: bridge4simulator MCP lets AI assistants like Cursor, Cloud Code, directly control iOS simulator, without wasting tokens.

items.title: Blooio
items.summary: iMessages API that scales to send blue bubbles from anywhere
items.content: The iMessages API for builders. Send iMessages with typing indicators, read receipts & high-res media. Native integrations for make.com, zapier, GoHighLevel, n8n, and more. + auto-fallback to RCS. Auto load balancing for number pools, risk management, contact stickiness, and so many cool features!
